dialogues.jp: 目の前には環の作った弁当がある。
dialogues.en: The boxed lunch that Tamaki made, laid in front of me.
dialogues.text: The boxed lunch that Tamaki made, laid in front of me.

dialogues.jp: こんな美しい弁当を見たことがない。
dialogues.en: I've never seen such a beautiful lunchbox before.
dialogues.text: I've never seen such a beautiful lunchbox before.

dialogues.jp:
購買で適当に買ってすませようと思っていた俺
に取っては、救世主のようなものだ。
dialogues.en:
It wouldn't look out of place at the front of a gourmet
restaurant. It's the saviour of my afternoon.
dialogues.text:
It wouldn't look out of place at the front of a gourmet
restaurant. It's the saviour of my afternoon.

dialogues.jp:
昼休憩になった直後、教室を出ると、環に声を
かけられた。
dialogues.en:
This all started when I heard Tamaki's voice calling out to
me while heading out the classroom...
dialogues.text:
This all started when I heard Tamaki's voice calling out to
me while heading out the classroom...

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よお、環」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Tamaki."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これから、お昼ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you going for lunch?"
dialogues.text: "Are you going for lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これから芝刈りに行くように見えるか？」
dialogues.en: "Does it look like I'm going lawn-mowing?"
dialogues.text: "Does it look like I'm going lawn-mowing?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……川にお洗濯じゃないですよね？」
dialogues.en: "...Washing clothes by the river, maybe?"
dialogues.text: "...Washing clothes by the river, maybe?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……もちろん、鬼退治でもないぞ」
dialogues.en: "...Obviously, it's demon exorcision."
dialogues.text: "...Obviously, it's demon exorcision."

dialogues.jp: おっと、こんな会話をしている場合ではない。
dialogues.en:
Whoops, this isn't the time for idle conversation like
this...
dialogues.text:
Whoops, this isn't the time for idle conversation like
this...

dialogues.jp: 少しでも早く行って、身のある食物を得ないと。
dialogues.en:
If I don't get a move on, there won't be anything edible
left.
dialogues.text:
If I don't get a move on, there won't be anything edible
left.

dialogues.jp: 「悪い、環。ちょっと急ぐから……」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, Tamaki, but I have to hurry..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Tamaki, but I have to hurry..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は会話を終わらせて購買へ行こうとすると、
dialogues.en: I started heading off to make my purchases, but...
dialogues.text: I started heading off to make my purchases, but...

dialogues.jp: 赤面して俯いたまま、環が尋ねる。
dialogues.en: Her red face staring at the ground, she meekly addressed me.
dialogues.text: Her red face staring at the ground, she meekly addressed me.

dialogues.jp: 「何？　何か用？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「ひょっとして、こ、これから購買へ行くので
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "A, are you perhaps, going to buy your lunch?"
dialogues.text: "A, are you perhaps, going to buy your lunch?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。そのつもりだけど……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I am..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I am..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたの？」
dialogues.en: "What about it?"
dialogues.text: "What about it?"

dialogues.jp:
環が何か言いたそうにしているのは分かるが、
何が言いたいのかは分からない。
dialogues.en:
I could understand what she was saying, but not what she was
hiding.
dialogues.text:
I could understand what she was saying, but not what she was
hiding.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「あの、もし迷惑でなければ、お弁当を作りす
　ぎてしまったので、一緒に食べませんか」
dialogues.en:
"Um, if it's no trouble to you... I made a little too much
for my own lunch... so I thought we could share it..."
dialogues.text:
"Um, if it's no trouble to you... I made a little too much
for my own lunch... so I thought we could share it..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: 棚からボタ餅か？
dialogues.en: Is this a trap?
dialogues.text: Is this a trap?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「め、迷惑ならいいんですけど……」
dialogues.en: "I, if it's a bother, it's fine..."
dialogues.text: "I, if it's a bother, it's fine..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「作りすぎたって……環の手作り？　マジで？
　いいの？」
dialogues.en:
"You made a little too much... you mean, you made it
yourself? Is it really okay for me to eat it too?"
dialogues.text:
"You made a little too much... you mean, you made it
yourself? Is it really okay for me to eat it too?"

dialogues.jp: 環は、真っ赤になって俯いたままである。
dialogues.en:
Her face, still boring holes into the floor, grew even
redder.
dialogues.text:
Her face, still boring holes into the floor, grew even
redder.

dialogues.jp:
弁当を作りすぎたことがそんなにも恥ずかしい
のだろうか？
dialogues.en: Is overcooking really that shameful?
dialogues.text: Is overcooking really that shameful?

dialogues.jp: 一緒に食卓を囲むのが照れくさいのか？
dialogues.en:
Or maybe she thinks eating from the same box would be
embarassing?
dialogues.text:
Or maybe she thinks eating from the same box would be
embarassing?

dialogues.jp:
しかし、そうなら弁当を一緒に食べようとは誘
わないだろう。
dialogues.en:
Although, if that was true, she wouldn't have asked me in
the first place...
dialogues.text:
Although, if that was true, she wouldn't have asked me in
the first place...

dialogues.jp: まあ、細かいことは考えるのをやめよう。
dialogues.en: Well, whatever. No point sweating the small stuff.
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. No point sweating the small stuff.

dialogues.jp:
一食分、浮いた。ラッキー。しかも環の手作り
ですぜ、ダンナ。
dialogues.en:
My meal for today is decided, lucky for me. And Tamaki made
it, so it'd be fit for a king most likely.
dialogues.text:
My meal for today is decided, lucky for me. And Tamaki made
it, so it'd be fit for a king most likely.

dialogues.jp: 「よし、じゃあ、お言葉に甘えるとするか」
dialogues.en: "Alright then, I gratefully accept."
dialogues.text: "Alright then, I gratefully accept."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、礼を言うのは俺だろう？」
dialogues.en: "Er, it should be me thanking you, no?"
dialogues.text: "Er, it should be me thanking you, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いいえ……本当、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "No... from the bottom of my heart, thank you."
dialogues.text: "No... from the bottom of my heart, thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「…………とりあえず、行くか」
dialogues.en: "......Anyway, let's go."
dialogues.text: "......Anyway, let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
俺と環は、ひとけのないところということで、
体育館裏へと移動した。
dialogues.en:
Our goal was to find a deserted area. We eventually landed
at the gym rear.
dialogues.text:
Our goal was to find a deserted area. We eventually landed
at the gym rear.

dialogues.jp: 言葉が無い。
dialogues.en: I was stunned.
dialogues.text: I was stunned.

dialogues.jp:
人間、感動すると言葉を失うというが、正にそ
の通りの情景が、今ここに、ある。
dialogues.en:
The sight before me taught me the real feeling of being
speechless.
dialogues.text:
The sight before me taught me the real feeling of being
speechless.

dialogues.jp: 今日は、お正月ですか？
dialogues.en: Is today the first day of the new year?
dialogues.text: Is today the first day of the new year?

dialogues.jp:
環が作りすぎたという弁当は、お重が五段になっ
ている。
dialogues.en:
The lunchbox she made was a tray of, essentially, a
five-course meal.
dialogues.text:
The lunchbox she made was a tray of, essentially, a
five-course meal.

dialogues.jp:
中身は全て和食だが、色とりどりに並べられ、
見た目で既に味わえるものである。
dialogues.en:
It was made entirely of typical Japanese food, all arranged
neatly and appetizingly.
dialogues.text:
It was made entirely of typical Japanese food, all arranged
neatly and appetizingly.

dialogues.jp: 「環、料理得意なんだな……」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, you must cook a lot..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, you must cook a lot..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ええ。作るのは好きなんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I like to cook."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I like to cook."

dialogues.jp: お重の中身を、皿に取り分けてくれている。
dialogues.en: The entire thing even came with plates.
dialogues.text: The entire thing even came with plates.

dialogues.jp: 何か、こういうのって、いいよな。
dialogues.en: This feels great, more like a picnic than a school lunch.
dialogues.text: This feels great, more like a picnic than a school lunch.

dialogues.jp:
女の子の女の子らしい姿は、やはり見ていてか
わいらしい。
dialogues.en: Seems like she's not girly only in looks.
dialogues.text: Seems like she's not girly only in looks.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「お口に合うかどうかわかりませんが……」
dialogues.en: "I do not know how good it tastes, but..."
dialogues.text: "I do not know how good it tastes, but..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、綺麗に盛られた皿を受け取り、
dialogues.en: My answer was simply to take the top of the stack of plates.
dialogues.text: My answer was simply to take the top of the stack of plates.

dialogues.jp: 「では、いただきます」
dialogues.en: "Shall we?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we?"

dialogues.jp: パンと、手を合わせた。
dialogues.en: I clapped my hands together.
dialogues.text: I clapped my hands together.

dialogues.jp: 環は、心配そうに俺を見つめている。
dialogues.en: Tamaki was staring at me, slightly worried.
dialogues.text: Tamaki was staring at me, slightly worried.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、まずサトイモの煮物を口に運んだ。
dialogues.en:
I started with piece of stewed potato, and brought it to my
mouth...
dialogues.text:
I started with piece of stewed potato, and brought it to my
mouth...

dialogues.jp: おっ。
dialogues.en: ...Wow.
dialogues.text: ...Wow.

dialogues.jp: このまろやかな味わい……。
dialogues.en: The mild taste...
dialogues.text: The mild taste...

dialogues.jp: サトイモの甘さと醤油のハーモニー。
dialogues.en:
The harmony between the soy sauce and the sweetness of the
potato...
dialogues.text:
The harmony between the soy sauce and the sweetness of the
potato...

dialogues.jp: 「うまい！」
dialogues.en: "Delicious!"
dialogues.text: "Delicious!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず叫んでしまった。
dialogues.en: I exclaimed what I felt, without thinking about it.
dialogues.text: I exclaimed what I felt, without thinking about it.

dialogues.jp: 音夢の料理とは違い、中身も本物だ。
dialogues.en:
This is as far from Nemu's cooking as it gets. This is the
real thing.
dialogues.text:
This is as far from Nemu's cooking as it gets. This is the
real thing.

dialogues.jp: 環は、ほっと息を吐いて。
dialogues.en: Tamaki then breathed a sigh of relief.
dialogues.text: Tamaki then breathed a sigh of relief.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった。頑張ったかいがありました」
dialogues.en: "I'm glad... I worked hard on it."
dialogues.text: "I'm glad... I worked hard on it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp: がんばったかいがありました？
dialogues.en: She worked hard on it?
dialogues.text: She worked hard on it?

dialogues.jp: それって、どういう意味だよ……。
dialogues.en: What does she mean by that...?
dialogues.text: What does she mean by that...?

dialogues.jp:
と、気にしながらも、五段全てを平らげてしまっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Before I came up with an answer, we'd finished the entire 5
courses.
dialogues.text:
Before I came up with an answer, we'd finished the entire 5
courses.

dialogues.jp: 「……余は満足じゃ」
dialogues.en: "...Now that was satisfying."
dialogues.text: "...Now that was satisfying."

dialogues.jp:
自販機で買ってきたお茶を飲みながら、食事の
余韻に浸っている。
dialogues.en: I sipped from a can of tea, washing down that amazing meal.
dialogues.text: I sipped from a can of tea, washing down that amazing meal.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「喜んでもらえて、本当によかったです」
dialogues.en: "I'm happy you enjoyed it."
dialogues.text: "I'm happy you enjoyed it."

dialogues.jp: 環はうれしそうに俺に言う。
dialogues.en: The happiness in her voice was clear.
dialogues.text: The happiness in her voice was clear.

dialogues.jp: これって。
dialogues.en: This, though.
dialogues.text: This, though.

dialogues.jp: 一人で食べるにしては、量が多すぎるよな……。
dialogues.en: This really was way too much for one person to finish...
dialogues.text: This really was way too much for one person to finish...

dialogues.jp: あれ？
ひょっとして、環のヤツ。
dialogues.en: Just maybe, that girl...
dialogues.text: Just maybe, that girl...

dialogues.jp: わざと、あんなにたくさん作ってきたのか？
dialogues.en: Maybe she made that much on purpose?
dialogues.text: Maybe she made that much on purpose?

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず環の表情をうかがう。
dialogues.en:
My thoughts must've been clear on my face, as Tamaki then
began talking.
dialogues.text:
My thoughts must've been clear on my face, as Tamaki then
began talking.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「どうかしましたか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there something amiss?"
dialogues.text: "Is there something amiss?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "Nah, it's nothing."
dialogues.text: "Nah, it's nothing."

dialogues.jp: ちょっと自意識過剰かな。
dialogues.en: I'm probably giving myself too much credit.
dialogues.text: I'm probably giving myself too much credit.

dialogues.jp:
まさか『俺のために作ってくれたの？』とは聞
けないしなぁ。
dialogues.en:
Asking whether she made it for me, would also be plain
embarassing, especially if I'm wrong...
dialogues.text:
Asking whether she made it for me, would also be plain
embarassing, especially if I'm wrong...

dialogues.jp:
ここは、素直に好意を受け取り、真意は敢えて
触れずにおこう。
dialogues.en:
I'll just accept the goodwill, and leave any hidden
intentions untouched.
dialogues.text:
I'll just accept the goodwill, and leave any hidden
intentions untouched.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あの、朝倉様……」
dialogues.en: "Um, Asakura-sama..."
dialogues.text: "Um, Asakura-sama..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「また作りすぎたら、手伝ってもらっていいで
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "If I make too much again, would you help me with it?"
dialogues.text: "If I make too much again, would you help me with it?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに、いつも作る量を間違えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that different from how much you usually make?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that different from how much you usually make?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ダメですか？」
dialogues.en: "...You won't?"
dialogues.text: "...You won't?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「いや、もちろんかまわないけどさ」
dialogues.en: "No, of course I will."
dialogues.text: "No, of course I will."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「よかった」
dialogues.en: "Then that is fine."
dialogues.text: "Then that is fine."

dialogues.jp: 作りすぎる予定か……。
dialogues.en: She's planning to overdo it again, isn't she...
dialogues.text: She's planning to overdo it again, isn't she...

dialogues.jp: ま、いいか。
dialogues.en: Well, whatever.
dialogues.text: Well, whatever.

dialogues.jp: おいしい弁当が食えるんだ。
dialogues.en: I get to eat more tasty lunches after all.
dialogues.text: I get to eat more tasty lunches after all.

dialogues.jp: それだけでよしとしよう。
dialogues.en: That can only be a good thing.
dialogues.text: That can only be a good thing.

dialogues.jp: ◆弁当はお重◆
dialogues.en: ◆The 5-Course Boxed Lunch?◆
dialogues.text: ◆The 5-Course Boxed Lunch?◆

dialogues.jp: 購買へ行こうとすると、環と出会う。
dialogues.en: On the way to buy my lunch, I bumped into Tamaki.
dialogues.text: On the way to buy my lunch, I bumped into Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
環は弁当を作りすぎたといって、俺に弁当を食
べて欲しいと言ってくる。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki had made too much for her lunch, and wanted to share
it with me.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki had made too much for her lunch, and wanted to share
it with me.

dialogues.jp:
お重で五段になっていて、確かに一人では食べ
きれない量だった。
dialogues.en:
After seeing and tasting the 5-course lunch for myself, I
definitely agreed that she had made too much.
dialogues.text:
After seeing and tasting the 5-course lunch for myself, I
definitely agreed that she had made too much.

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとして、俺を誘うために作ってくれたの
だろうか……。
dialogues.en: Though maybe, she made that much on purpose...
dialogues.text: Though maybe, she made that much on purpose...
